sections.headline: About Me
paragraphs: I’m a Senior Copywriter and Creative with over a decade of experience turning strategic briefs into ideas and words for brands across entertainment, sport, culture, technology and education.

In my current role at Skydance, I develop copy and creative for HBO Max and TNT Sports across EMEA as part of our in-house creative team. I take briefs from initial concept through to execution across social, digital, CRM, outdoor, trailers, radio and wider brand campaigns. Most recently, I led copy for the UK launch of HBO Max.

Much of my role also involves shaping how brands sound. I own HBO Max’s tone-of-voice guides and messaging frameworks, and work across brands with very different personalities. That means developing and adapting the writing for different audiences, channels and markets while keeping each brand’s underlying identity coherent.

Before this role, I worked at FutureLearn and in agencies, developing work for organisations including Google, LEGO, Tate Modern, the National Theatre, Universal and Fox. Those roles gave me experience moving between campaign ideas, brand narratives, product messaging and long-form editorial. My film work includes scripting trailers for Boyhood and the National Theatre, and developing the idea and script for Tate Modern’s The World Goes Pop.

My background is editorial as well as commercial. I started my writing career as a music and film journalist, interviewing artists and filmmakers and writing features and profiles. I later produced long-form editorial and interview pieces at FutureLearn, alongside my campaign work. Writing at length remains an important part of my experience, as does writing scripts for television, radio, theatrical and social.

I enjoy the collaborative side of copywriting just as much as the writing itself. I regularly present and defend ideas to senior stakeholders, work closely with designers and regional teams, and manage two junior writers. Alongside my own writing, I edit and shape their work before it becomes English master copy for multiple markets.

projects.title: HBO Max UK Launch Campaign
projects.meta: HBO Max · OOH · 2026 · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: I led copy for the UK launch of HBO Max in 2026, writing across radio, outdoor, social, email and display. I pushed for UK-specific lines that spoke to local places and content, like “The best new platform since 9¾.”
That line ran as a takeover of the tunnel at King's Cross, and the ad went viral on LinkedIn. Across the launch as a whole, UK subscriptions passed the yearly target within four months.
The same tone ran through the launch emails, including the welcome email for new subscribers.

related.label: See the HBO Max welcome email

projects.title: HBO Max Wall-to-Wall Watercooler Campaign
projects.meta: HBO Max · OOH brand campaign · Autumn 2026 · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: This outdoor brand campaign ran in autumn 2026, at a point when HBO Max was between big new releases. With no single launch to shout about, the idea was to remind people how much is already there: a back catalogue full of the shows everyone has talked about for years.

“Wall-to-Wall Watercooler” was the broader copy concept, turning that breadth into one simple promise: on HBO Max, there’s always something people are talking about. For this update to the campaign I added the subtitle, “Critically acclaimed, publicly debated”, which makes the point that these are shows people argue over as well as admire.
Each poster put characters from different eras of HBO side by side, keeping the brand front of mind until the next big release.

projects.title: HBO Max Trailers for Cinema, TV and Radio
projects.meta: HBO Max · Trailers · Cinema, TV & radio · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: I develop trailer ideas and write scripts for HBO Max. The Hungarian documentary and Halloween campaigns show how that work came to life.

projects.title: Pogány Induló Documentary Trailer for HBO Max
projects.meta: HBO Max · Hungarian original documentary series · Trailer concept & script · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: Pogány Induló is a Hungarian rapper, real name Marcell Szirmai, who became one of the country's biggest music stars by the age of twenty.
For HBO Max's four-part documentary series about him, Pogány Induló: Vajon mit mondana anya (What Would Mum Say?), I came up with the concept for the trailer and wrote the script.
My concept shows him walking alone against the crowd, with his own lyrics projected onto him. He's a lone wolf, weighed down by his words.

images.caption: Pogány Induló: Vajon mit mondana anya, HBO Max

projects.title: Boyhood Trailer
projects.meta: Universal · Trailer script · Empire Design
body: At Empire Design, I scripted an emotive trailer for Universal's release of Boyhood, Richard Linklater's film shot over twelve years with the same cast.

The film follows one boy, Mason, from the age of six to eighteen, with Patricia Arquette and Ethan Hawke as his parents. That process was what made the film unique, so the script had to explain it quickly, then let the footage do the emotional work as Mason grows up on screen.
The trailer gained 5.5 million views on YouTube, and was also shown on TV in America.

projects.title: Mock the Week Print Ad for TLC
projects.meta: TLC · Print · Warner Bros. Discovery
projects.quote: Heard we were finished? Fake news.
body: I wrote this print ad for Mock the Week on TLC, turning the idea that the show was ‘finished’ into the punchline.

projects.title: Swallows and Amazons Tagline
projects.meta: Swallows and Amazons · Film tagline · AKA UK
body: At AKA UK, I wrote the tagline for the 2016 film of Swallows and Amazons, based on Arthur Ransome's classic children's novel.

projects.title: HBO Max Halloween 2026 Campaign
projects.meta: HBO Max · Halloween 2026 · Campaign concept · AV & online · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: For Halloween 2026 on HBO Max, I came up with the campaign line: “Fear hits home.”

The line has a double meaning. It speaks to the quality of the horror on HBO Max, the kind that really gets to you, and to the Home in Home Box Office: you don’t have to leave the house to be terrified.
The line flexed across AV and online assets, from the trailer to display creative.

projects.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Gamified Journey
projects.meta: HBO Max app · A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms · Interactive retention campaign · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: We needed to keep A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms viewers watching throughout the show’s debut season.
My solution was an interactive journey in the HBO Max app. Episode by episode, users took quizzes and played games to work their way up from stable hand to knight.
The in-season gamification drove an uplift of around 16–18% through consistent episode progression.

images.caption: Result screen for getting every answer wrong

projects.cardTitle: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

projects.title: ATG Theatres: Business Deserves a Bigger Stage
projects.meta: ATG Theatres · Corporate nights out & venue hire · LinkedIn concept · AKA UK
body: At AKA, part of ATG, I worked on attracting corporate clients to theatres. The creative challenge was different from selling tickets: I wanted businesses to see a West End theatre as somewhere special for their next corporate night out.

“Business deserves a bigger stage” gives that idea a simple, memorable line. A LinkedIn execution set against the Lyceum Theatre shows how the venue itself can do the selling — a famous West End theatre that makes a company night out feel like an occasion.

images.caption: ATG Theatres corporate venue hire LinkedIn advertising concept featuring the Lyceum Theatre

projects.title: Noodoll: Ricespud Product Messaging
projects.meta: Noodoll · Ecommerce · Product descriptions
body: At Noodoll, I wrote product copy designed to bring the characters to life while helping customers understand what they're buying. Ricespud needed a playful, distinctive voice alongside clear descriptions of the product.
From “Are you ready for spud at first sight?” to the softness, embroidered features and little arms for hugs, the writing brings the character into the shopping experience.

images.caption: Noodoll Ricespud product page showing the plush and the product copy I wrote

projects.title: HBO Max Lifecycle Email
projects.meta: HBO Max · EMEA · Onboarding, retention and win-back
body: I write English master copy for HBO Max lifecycle email across EMEA, from onboarding to retention and win-back. That includes subject lines, content modules and calls to action.

For this UK launch welcome email, I used The White Lotus to bring the HBO Max voice into the first email a new subscriber saw. ‘Take a deep breath…’ leads into ‘And dive in’, giving the button a reason to sound like part of the email.

projects.title: FutureLearn: Course SEO & Editorial
projects.meta: FutureLearn · Search-led course titles · Long-form articles
body: At FutureLearn, I used keyword research and search-results analysis to write course titles that would rank well while still making sense to prospective learners. ‘Power Dressing in the Zoom Era’ is one example of balancing clear search intent with useful, engaging copy.

I also researched and wrote longer editorial pieces, often based on interviews with educators. These two examples show the range: precise, discovery-led course messaging and more expansive storytelling, including an article exploring Ancient Rome.

images.caption: FutureLearn course page: Power Dressing in the Zoom Era, showing search-informed course-title copy
FutureLearn long-form editorial article: Explore a virtual map of Ancient Rome

projects.title: FutureLearn × Google: Course Product Copy
projects.meta: FutureLearn × Google for Education · Course landing page · Product copy
body: At FutureLearn, I wrote product copy for online courses, including this Google for Education course aimed at teachers and educators.

The course title is ‘Google For Education: Staying Organised and Improving Communication’. The introduction opens with ‘Communicate effectively with staff, students, and parents, and save time as an educator…’

images.caption: Google for Education course artwork used on the FutureLearn landing page

projects.title: TNT Sports CRM, Including Paris 2024
projects.meta: TNT Sports · Paris 2024 · CRM · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: I lead master CRM for HBO Max and TNT Sports across EMEA, from onboarding to win-back. When we took on TNT Sports' CRM, I worked with their marketing team to rebuild the emails around user data. Our CRM now performs better than any other WBD region.
For Paris 2024, a large batch of Olympics comms landed just before deadline. I used automation to deliver it on time, during what became our highest-ever period for new subscriptions.

projects.title: Milano Cortina 2026 Interactive Campaign
projects.meta: HBO Max · TNT Sports · Milano Cortina 2026 · Warner Bros. Discovery
body: I come up with interactive campaigns for TNT Sports users. For the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics, I created a pick-your-sports journey: users chose the sports they cared about from all 16 on the programme, so we only sent them the notifications that mattered to them.
The final screen asked them to turn on push notifications, so they were ready for the opening ceremony on 6 February.

projects.title: The World Goes Pop Trailer for Tate Modern
projects.meta: Tate Modern · Trailer · AKA UK
body: For Tate Modern's exhibition The EY Exhibition: The World Goes Pop, I came up with the idea for the trailer, wrote the script and helped on the shoot.

I thought the Japanese pop star Kyary Pamyu Pamyu, with her surrealist sensibility, would be perfect for it. I contacted her team, and the stars aligned: she was in London for a show, so we could shoot with her while she was here.

images.caption: The World Goes Pop, Tate Modern

projects.title: Home, I’m Darling Trailer for the National Theatre
projects.meta: National Theatre · Trailer script · AKA UK
body: Laura Wade's play Home, I'm Darling follows Judy, a woman who chooses to live as a perfect 1950s housewife in the present day.
I wrote the National Theatre's trailer to match: a script in the style of a 1950s TV commercial that sells the dream, then hints at the cracks beneath it. It has more than 200,000 views on YouTube.

images.caption: Home, I'm Darling trailer, National Theatre

projects.title: Whales: Beneath the Surface Trailer for the Natural History Museum
projects.meta: Natural History Museum · Trailer concept, script & edit · AKA UK
body: For the Natural History Museum's exhibition Whales: Beneath the Surface, I came up with the idea for the trailer, wrote the script and helped with the edit.
I wanted to tap into the sense of mystery whales evoke, and found Heathcote Williams’ poem Whale Nation. The trailer is built around an extract from it.

images.caption: Whales: Beneath the Surface, Natural History Museum

projects.title: Matilda the Musical Social, Video & Radio
projects.meta: Matilda The Musical · Social, video & radio · AKA UK
body: At AKA UK, for Matilda The Musical, I came up with ideas for social and video content, wrote the scripts, went along to the shoots and edited the videos myself in Adobe Premiere Pro.
Meet the Matildas introduced the young actors taking on the title role, showing audiences the new cast before they stepped on stage.
I also scripted and edited Matilda’s radio trailers.

images.caption: Meet the Matildas, Matilda The Musical

projects.title: Westminster Abbey: Feel Wonder First Hand
projects.meta: Westminster Abbey · Visitor campaign · Outdoor · AKA UK
body: For this Westminster Abbey campaign, the visual showed the Abbey balanced on an outstretched hand. My job was to find the line that made the image and the idea click together.
I wrote “Feel wonder first hand.” It worked with the visual but also said something about the experience of visiting the Abbey and seeing its history and architecture for yourself.

images.caption: The campaign at Bond Street station

projects.title: City & Guilds and FutureLearn Skills Campaign
projects.meta: City & Guilds × FutureLearn · Campaign
body: For City & Guilds' new skills courses, I created ‘The New World Needs You’, a campaign encouraging young people to see a place for themselves in the post-pandemic world. We extended the idea into sector-specific paid creative.

projects.title: FutureLearn Results Day Outdoor Campaign
projects.meta: FutureLearn · OOH
body: I wrote copy for a fast-turnaround Results Day OOH campaign aimed at Gen Z, reframing failure as part of the journey rather than the end of it.

projects.title: Brand Voice
projects.meta: HBO Max · Skydance · FutureLearn
body: I own HBO Max’s tone-of-voice guides and messaging frameworks, and work across brands with very different personalities.
The guide describes HBO Max as quick-witted. “We’ve an easy wit” gives writers and reviewers a shared reference for how far to push a joke. The welcome email shows how that can sound in practice.
My English master copy for HBO Max and TNT Sports is translated into 17 languages and reaches more than 10 million people a week, so the voice has to hold in every market.

At FutureLearn, I wrote the company’s first brand tone-of-voice guide. I also created the mnemonic STEP (Social, Transformative, Experimental, Purposeful), inspired by the FutureLearn logo, to help staff remember our brand values.
